body:
Recovery recipe, proven on TermAl's WinB on 2026-11-27 (Engram defect w-c39164e2c07b, route by Engram::Opus, approved by Engram::Fable).
Symptom: ordinary import refuses with task_sync_divergent_planning on an item the LOCAL host revised. Cause: a task held (ancestor_binding) in the same graph component (here w-c4a1 and w-0892, siblings under w-e297, whose root had the w-7e7c claim's active execution) makes import re-read the locally revised item. Export refuses with task_sync_incremental_basis_unavailable because data HEAD isn't the admitted basis. Engram's printed set-aside remedy LOOPS in that state.
ROUTE C, which only moves forward:
0. Capture read-only diagnostics (import --dry-run --json, the envelope).
1. The item's holder saves `show <item> --full`.
2. `git revert --no-edit <set-aside>` if one was made.
3. The holder revises the item back to its text at the basis commit.
4. Ordinary import. Central's changes apply; siblings stay held, which is fine.
5. The holder re-applies the saved revise exactly.
6. Ordinary export, commit, confirm-import, a net check against the incoming tip (zero deletions, disclosure clean), HTTPS fast-forward push.
NOT approved: a branch reset (A) or export --rebuild (B).
Prevention: a local criteria revise on an item with held siblings will hit this again until w-c391 lands. If that's foreseeable, run the revise on Central, or sync before revising.
